mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.25% signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in economic stimulus.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.25% (Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 8.0% signals deep recessionary conditions that trigger market anticipation of policy responses, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the economy approaches a recovery inflection point.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 8.0 (t-test p > 0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) below their 3-month moving averages signal a broad-based consumer sector collapse, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in eventual stabilization.
failure_condition: The joint decline (both series below 3-month MA) fails to predict positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: Manufacturing production (INDPRO) declining below 95 during a deep recession signals the economic contraction is nearing its trough, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as policy responses accelerate.
failure_condition: In deep recession periods (UNRATE > 8.0), INDPRO < 95 fails to predict positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A low level of non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) below 135,000 thousand signals severe labor market contraction that precedes equity market rebounds as the economy approaches recovery, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The correlation between PAYEMS level and 5-day SPX returns is not significantly positive (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Inflation (CPIAUCSL) falling below 2.0% signals deflationary risks that prompt aggressive monetary stimulus, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market anticipates policy intervention.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL < 2.0 (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in real GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) below their 6-month moving averages signal a severe economic contraction that precedes market stabilization, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline (both series below 6-month MA) fails to predict positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: In a near-zero interest rate regime (FEDFUNDS < 0.25%), the S&P 500 produces positive forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in eventual economic recovery and policy normalization.
failure_condition: In near-zero interest rate regimes (FEDFUNDS < 0.25), 60-day SPX returns are negative in more than 60% of cases (Rank IC < 0.03).
